'''Aram Arutyunov''' ({{langx|ru|Ара́м Влади́мирович Арутю́нов}}) (born 1956) is a [[Russian mathematician]], [[Professor (highest academic rank)|Professor]], [[Doctor of Science|Dr.Sc.]], a professor at the [[MSU CMC|Faculty of Computer Science at the Moscow State University]] and the [[Peoples' Friendship University of Russia]].<ref>[https://cs.msu.ru/persons/35744 MSU CMC]{{in lang|ru}}</ref>

He defended the thesis «Perturbation of optimal control problems and necessary conditions for the extremum of the first and second order» for the degree of [[Doctor of Science|Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences]] (1988). and was awarded the title of [[Professor (highest academic rank)|Professor]] (1991). He has authored seven books and 318 scientific articles.<ref>[https://istina.msu.ru/profile/av_arutyunov/ Scientific works of Aram Arutyunov]</ref><ref>[http://www.mathnet.ru/php/person.phtml?personid=8380&option_lang=eng Scientific works of Aram Arutyunov]{{in lang|en}}</ref>
